# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Package documentation modernization**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release delivers compiler-generated XML documentation alongside managed packages. API documentation is now authored with C# XML comments, while the bundled renderer incorporates the latest m154 upstream fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m154 upstream fixes merged** — The bundled Skia engine incorporates the latest Chrome m154 upstream corrections. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## API Surface

- **Managed packages include XML documentation** — Compiler-generated XML documentation is packaged with managed assemblies so IDE help and API documentation stay aligned with the shipped surface. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
